stages.title: Empty database
stages.explanation: A fresh schema has no payroll rows.

stages.title: Source records
stages.explanation: Components define meaning; earnings are entitlements, while instructions are monthly or one-time inputs. L2 settings are auxiliary.

stages.title: Draft snapshot
stages.explanation: payroll.draft fixes source versions, content hash, and totals; payroll_draft_ledger holds its monetary effects. Resolution records describe candidate instruction treatment.

stages.title: Commit blocked by hold
stages.explanation: The hold is a new payroll.draft.control revision. The rejected commit appends no monetary rows, application, or receipt.

stages.title: Hold released
stages.explanation: A later control revision releases the same immutable draft.

stages.title: Optional exact review
stages.explanation: The review binds this draft content hash and control revision. This journey records it, although commit policy does not require approval.

stages.title: Committed atomically
stages.explanation: Posted entries, the instruction application, and the durable payroll.commit receipt appear together. The draft and its resolution stay unchanged.

stages.title: Employer obligation
stages.explanation: The obligation references the exact posted employer-liability entry and establishes INR 3,000 due.

stages.title: Challan-backed remittance
stages.explanation: The remittance proves INR 2,000 was paid. It does not itself reduce the obligation's outstanding amount.

stages.title: Payment allocated
stages.explanation: Allocation connects the remittance to the obligation, reducing outstanding liability from INR 3,000 to INR 1,000.
